name: Langostino
description: Langostino - An open-source autonomous drone platform using ROS2 and AI-powered flight control. A complete reference implementation for building, understanding, and extending real-world drone autonomy.
readme_summary: Langostino is an open-source autonomous drone platform utilizing ROS2 and AI for advanced flight control. It serves as a comprehensive reference implementation for developing, understanding, and extending drone autonomy, enabling users to build and fly their own AI-powered drones.
key_features: Open-source autonomous flight platform
ROS2 integration
AI-powered flight control
Reference implementation for drone autonomy
Community-driven development
Build-it-yourself drone assembly guides
AI autopilot capabilities
primary_use_case: To provide a complete, open-source reference implementation for building and operating autonomous drones powered by AI and ROS2, enabling users to understand, extend, and deploy drone autonomy.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, semi-transparent drone hovering in a vibrant, abstract digital landscape. The drone's core is glowing with AI energy, projecting a holographic path forward. Below it, a stylized blueprint of the drone is being assembled by robotic arms made of code. Subtle data streams flow from the drone to a small, unobtrusive screen displaying 'ROS2 Autonomy' and 'AI Flight Control'. The overall mood is innovative and futuristic, with a clean, 3D isometric illustration style emphasizing clarity and the blend of hardware and software. The repository name 'Langostino' is subtly integrated into the drone's design.

name: File_Converter_Pro
description: Free offline all-in-one file converter for Windows. Converts documents, images, audio and video locally. No uploads, no internet, no dependencies. Built with Python & PySide6. Features dark/light theme, stats dashboard, achievements, and multi-engine fallback.
readme_summary: File Converter Pro is a free, offline, all-in-one file conversion application for Windows. It supports documents, images, audio, and video, operating entirely locally without internet access or dependencies. The application features a polished user interface with dark/light themes, a statistics dashboard, and gamified achievements.
key_features: All-in-one file conversion (documents, images, audio, video)
100% offline and private operation
Batch conversion support
Statistics dashboard and gamified achievements
Automation via watch folders and scheduled tasks
Windows context menu integration
Community-driven language support (i18n)
primary_use_case: To provide users with a free, private, and comprehensive offline tool for converting various file types on Windows.
cover_image_prompt: A magical workbench in a cozy, dimly lit workshop. On the workbench, various raw materials like crumpled documents, unformatted images, raw audio waves, and video reels are being fed into a central, ornate machine labeled 'File Converter Pro'. The machine, glowing with soft light, is simultaneously outputting perfectly formed, polished versions of each item – a crisp document, a vibrant photo, a clear audio waveform, and a smooth video stream. Subtle digital particles flow from the inputs to the outputs, representing the conversion process. The scene should evoke a sense of effortless transformation and privacy, with a 3D isometric illustration style, rich textures, and a warm, inviting color palette.

name: netwatch
description: Real-time network diagnostics in your terminal. One command, zero config, instant visibility.
readme_summary: NetWatch is a real-time network diagnostics tool that runs in the terminal. It provides instant visibility into network activity, decodes encrypted traffic, identifies processes behind connections, and detects potential threats like malware beaconing or data exfiltration over DNS. It aims to consolidate the functionality of bandwidth meters, Wireshark triage views, and intrusion detectors into a single, zero-configuration binary.
key_features: Real-time network monitoring in the terminal
Decodes encrypted traffic
Identifies processes associated with network connections
Detects network threats (malware, port scans, data exfiltration)
Provides issue diagnosis, probable cause, and remediation suggestions
Learns network baselines and alerts on deviations
Zero-configuration setup
Scalable views (dense to lite)
primary_use_case: To provide real-time, in-depth network diagnostics and security monitoring directly within the terminal for network professionals, incident responders, and system administrators.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant digital detective, wearing a magnifying glass as a monocle, stands in a bustling, abstract cityscape representing a computer network. The detective is holding a glowing, transparent tablet that displays a live, dynamic flow of data packets. Some packets are colored red, indicating threats, while others are green, showing normal traffic. The detective points towards a specific red packet, causing a small, stylized 'NetWatch' logo to appear next to it, highlighting the threat. Subtle background elements include faint code snippets and network topology lines. The overall mood is one of focused investigation and clarity amidst complexity. The style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a vibrant, yet controlled, color palette.

name: FreeToken
description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently.
readme_summary: FreeToken is an edge-native serving engine designed to run large, frontier-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models efficiently on consumer hardware. It unifies heterogeneous edge resources like GPUs and CPUs into a single inference platform, enabling high-speed local execution of massive models.
key_features: Fast Edge-Native Runtime with bandwidth-adaptive CPU–GPU co-execution
Semantic-Aware Caching for recurrent state and KV caches
Elastic Memory Management for dynamic VRAM re-allocation
Broad MoE & Ecosystem Support for various models and quantization formats
Diverse Consumer Hardware Support, including NVIDIA RTX series GPUs
primary_use_case: Running large-scale AI models locally on personal computers and consumer hardware with high performance.
cover_image_prompt: A powerful, yet compact, desktop computer acting as a central hub, with glowing tendrils of light extending outwards to connect with various consumer devices like a gaming PC, a laptop, and even a smartphone. These tendrils represent the AI intelligence flowing from the hub to power these devices. The computer itself has a subtle 'FreeToken' logo integrated into its design. In the background, abstract representations of complex neural networks are being simplified and streamlined into accessible data packets. The overall mood is one of democratized access to advanced AI, with a clean, modern aesthetic and vibrant, energetic lighting. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear visual metaphor and subtle technological elements.

name: ai-copywriter
description: An AI copywriter that uses real copywriting skills + real marketing knowledge with human tone.
readme_summary: This AI copywriter is a Python-based agent skill that generates compelling marketing copy, such as headlines and product descriptions, while ensuring it reads naturally and avoids AI detection. It achieves this by integrating real copywriting techniques and marketing knowledge, focusing on the reader's emotions and simplifying explanations.
key_features: Writes attention-grabbing copy (clickbait titles, short descriptions, microcopy, subject lines)
Removes AI-generated writing patterns for a human tone
Built on blader's Humanizer for AI pattern detection and correction
Incorporates marketing research from enso.bot for effective communication
Focuses on reader's feelings and simplest explanation of concepts
Interviews user for ICP, category, and story to ensure authentic and engaging copy
Pressure-tests stories for interesting and surprising elements
Outputs copy in plain Markdown for broad compatibility
primary_use_case: To generate human-sounding, effective marketing copy that converts by understanding the target audience's emotions and simplifying complex concepts.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan sculptor, with a chisel and hammer, meticulously shaping a block of raw, unrefined stone into a smooth, elegant statue that clearly represents a human face. The stone block has faint, glitchy digital patterns that the sculptor is carefully chiseling away. The finished statue radiates a warm, inviting glow, symbolizing natural human communication. In the background, subtle UI elements show text being refined and simplified. The scene is a bright, clean workshop, emphasizing craftsmanship and clarity. The overall style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and a focus on the transformation from digital imperfection to human perfection, with the repository name 'AI Copywriter' subtly etched on the sculptor's workbench.
